title: Generic flatness on one affine source chart
statement: Let X and S be affine schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum], let S be integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], and let f : X → S be locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. There exists a nonzero global section a ∈ Γ(S, O_S) such that the restriction f^{-1}(D(a)) → D(a) is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism].

source.place: Tag 052A, applying Tag 051T to the coordinate algebra of one affine source chart

proof.text: The global-section ring of S is a domain. The global-section map φ = f.appTop is finite type. Apply the algebraic generic-flatness statement to obtain a nonzero a and flatness of R → B → T for every localization T of B at φ(a).

Let V be the basic open D(φ(a)) of X. Mathlib Γ_restrict_isLocalization identifies Γ(V, top) as a localization of B at φ(a). The affine criterion HasRingHomProperty.iff_of_isAffine therefore proves Flat (V.ι ≫ f).

Scheme.preimage_basicOpen identifies V with f^{-1}(D(a)). The equality morphismRestrict_ι expresses V.ι ≫ f as the restricted morphism followed by D(a).ι. Flatness cancels the open immersion at the target via MorphismProperty.of_postcomp.
